changes_made: Converted from FBX and TGA to GLB and PNG in Blender 5.2: the highest-detail mesh kept, the 3ds Max materials rebuilt as PBR (colour and normal maps; specular maps left out), hair and eyelashes set to alpha cutout, the one-frame bind clip dropped. Rig (Bip01 skeleton) and face blendshapes kept. Then meshopt-compressed web files, KTX2 textures, LODs, a mobile tier, an uncompressed engine tier and convex collision hulls.
local_changes: Cooked at load by native/eo-agents/src/rocketbox.rs: blendshapes dropped, tiers mapped (full mesh hero, lod1 near, lod2 mid, lod3 far), materials packed into one 1024 px BC atlas per avatar with roughness by material class, the face rig folded into the head, moved by the Rocketbox clips and the 100STYLE walks (motion.rs). The downloaded files are not modified.
